description: The proportion of unique non-stop-word tokens does not exceed the proportion of non-stop-word tokens.
explanation: Unique non-stop tokens are a subset of all non-stop tokens, and both proportions use the article body token count as denominator.

description: The mean historical shares for worst-performing keywords do not exceed those for middle-performing keywords, which do not exceed those for best-performing keywords.
explanation: The keyword groups are ranked by their historical average shares before the current article, so their corresponding average-share features are ordered by rank.

description: The mean historical shares for middle-performing keywords do not exceed those for best-performing keywords.
explanation: The middle and best keyword groups are ordered by their pre-publication average share ranking.

description: The least positive-word polarity is at least the most neutral negative-word polarity.
explanation: Positive-word polarity scores are on the nonnegative side of the sentiment scale, whereas negative-word polarity scores are nonpositive; consequently every positive score is no lower than every negative score.

description: The average polarity of positive words is at least the average polarity of negative words.
explanation: Every positive-word polarity is no lower than every negative-word polarity on the signed sentiment scale, so their means preserve that ordering.

description: The maximum positive-word polarity is at least the minimum negative-word polarity.
explanation: Positive sentiment scores are no lower than negative sentiment scores on the signed polarity scale.
